title: NonCommercial Gray Area Sorter
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: Judge ten uses of a CC BY-NC worksheet as clearly allowed, unclear (ask the owner), or likely not allowed.

learningObjectives: The learner will judge whether each of ten uses of a CC BY-NC resource is clearly allowed, unclear, or likely not allowed, with at least 8 of 10 correct on the first attempt.
prerequisites: The terms NonCommercial requirement, CC BY-NC, and attribution requirement

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Predict, commit an answer, and read the reason
keyQuestions: Does anyone earn money from this use?
When is the right answer to ask the owner?
commonMisconceptions: Selling at cost is always noncommercial
Advertising on a free page does not count as commercial
assessmentOpportunities: A blog with paid ads posts the worksheet. Which bin?
A nonprofit workshop charges $20 to cover room and printing. Which bin?
Does "free of charge" settle the question?

controls.name: Three bin buttons
controls.description: place the use in a bin. The placement is final.

controls.name: Show definitions
controls.description: on a narrow screen the criterion and bin definitions move behind this button.

controls.name: Previous missed / Next missed** and **Play again** on the results screen.
